# GECCO Workshop on Real-Parameter Black-Box Optimization Benchmarking (BBOB 2010)

The second GECCO Workshop on Real-Parameter
Black-Box Optimization Benchmarking (BBOB 2010) took place
during GECCO 2010 in Portland, Oregan, USA.


## Previous Web Page
You can find the previous webpage for this workshop at the 
[Internet Archive](https://web.archive.org/web/20200924110352/https://coco.gforge.inria.fr/doku.php?id=bbob-2010).
